facts.fact: StackAdapt describes a brand lift study as a tactic that surveys people exposed to a campaign across programmatic channels to show the impact of campaigns on audience perception or awareness.
facts.quote: A brand lift study is a tactic for uncovering the impact of your campaigns in influencing audience perception or to set a baseline for awareness.

facts.fact: StackAdapt defines brand lift as the percentage increase in the primary objective of a campaign, as measured by the study.
facts.quote: “Brand lift” is the percentage increase in the primary objective of a campaign, which is measured by the study.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, brand lift measurement compares survey results from users exposed to an ad with results from a control group of users who were not exposed.
facts.quote: by comparing their results against the results from users in a control group who have not been exposed to your ad.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that a brand lift study shows incremental lift through metrics such as brand awareness, ad recall, brand favourability, and brand affinity.
facts.quote: A brand lift study will show incremental lift through metrics like brand awareness, ad recall, brand favourability, and brand affinity.

facts.fact: StackAdapt announced its StackAdapt Brand Lift product as a brand new proprietary product.
facts.quote: we’ve developed a brand new proprietary product: StackAdapt Brand Lift!

facts.fact: StackAdapt says its Brand Lift solution provides real-time incrementality measurement of advertising impact on business goals.
StackAdapt gives 'Have you seen this ad in the past 30 days?' as an example question a brand lift study can answer.
facts.quote: Have you seen this ad in the past 30 days?
